definitions.explanation: In Japanese comedy (especially manzai), the role of the person who corrects or retorts to the boke's (funny man's) absurd statements. By extension, also refers to the act of making such retorts in everyday conversation.

examples.japanese: ツッコミ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧⟦ね→ね：09474_ne⟧。
⟦そこ→そこ：00991_soko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ツッコミ⟦{入|い}れて→入れる：01098_ireru⟧⟦よ→よ：09475_yo⟧。
examples.english: Come on, you're supposed to retort there.

examples.japanese: ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧ツッコミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: To retort to the funny man's joke.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誰|だれ}も→誰も：18610_daremo⟧ツッコんで⟦くれない→くれる：00724_kureru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{滑|すべ}った→滑る：01230_suberu⟧。
examples.english: Nobody gave me a retort, so my joke fell flat.

notes:
ツッコミ comes from manzai (⟦{漫才|まんざい}→漫才：04458_manzai⟧) comedy, where a duo consists of a ⟦ボケ→ボケ：08822_boke⟧ (funny man who says absurd things) and a ツッコミ (straight man who corrects them).

Common expressions:
- ツッコミ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧ (to make a retort)
- ツッコミ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (the straight man role)
- ⟦{鋭|するど}い→鋭い：02347_surudoi⟧ツッコミ (sharp comeback)

The verb form ツッコむ means to make a retort. In casual conversation, ツッコむ and ツッコミ are used even outside of comedy contexts when someone points out flaws or absurdities in what others say.
